cmd: new tile grass 24x24 palette=mossy-ruins wrap=on cell=24x24 bg=none

def grass() {

  noise ramp=moss weights=0,4,10,0,0 cluster=3..6 density=0.07 base=keep
  scatter stamp=blade count=12 minDist=5 flip=on
  scatter stamp=tuft count=3 minDist=10 flip=on
  scatter c=lichen count=2 minDist=10
}
